name: enzae-chameleon
description: enzae Chameleon - a 3D multiplayer hide-and-seek browser game

scripts.build: npm run build -w @enzae/shared && npm run build -w @enzae/server && npm run build -w @enzae/client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c blue,green,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @enzae/server && npm run typecheck -w @enzae/client
